items.name: color-input
items.title: Color input
items.description: Swatch, hex text field and native colour picker kept in sync inside a Field. Typed hex (3 or 6 digits, # optional) is normalised to #rrggbb on blur; invalid text is flagged and restored.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Value is always lower-case #rrggbb. The swatch is the visible face of the native picker, which keeps its own accessible name (pickerLabel).
